summary: Live Oak Mountain lookout, Douglas FPA: station by 1934, house on a timber tower built 1937, staffed to 1962, removed around 1973; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 14 x 14 lookout house on a wooden tower (1937)
facts.status_note: Lookout removed around 1973; no source read describes the site today.

corrections.why: The register and firelookout.com both give 20 feet. The 50-foot figure traces to an August 1934 proposal for a 40 to 50 foot tower; the 1937 account describes a 10-foot tower, the one source that disagrees with 20 feet.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com say 20 feet; the 1937 account says a 10-foot timber tower. Facts use 20 feet because two of three sources agree. The 40 to 50 foot figure was a proposal, not the built height.
A station was running by 1934 (staff and panorama), but the register and the 1937 account date the lookout house on its tower to 1937. The story separates the station from the house.
The register says removed around 1973; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1973; the Oregon lookout-history page says removed in 1973. Same year, different wording.

sources.title: Live Oak Mtn. Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Height conflict: register and firelookout.com say 20 feet; the 1937 item says 10 feet; the brief's 15.2 m (50 ft) traces to the 1934 proposal and is corrected above. No source read describes the site today or public access. Two web searches found nothing about the current site. The ORWW Osbornes Project page for Live Oak Mountain (orww.org/Osbornes_Project/Douglas/Live_Oak_Mountain/index.html) returned 404. Staffing comes from one history site that quotes local newspapers; the 1957 and 1962 items are the latest named staff. 'Douglas FPA' is not expanded in the story because no source read spells it out.
